english.title: Fail to give name / address to person accredited under the Police Reform Act 2002 - engaging in anti-social behaviour
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person whom a person accredited under the Police Reform Act 2002 had reason to believe

(A)_[had engaged]_
(B)_[was engaging]_

in anti-social behaviour, namely **(..SPECIFY THE BEHAVIOUR..),

(C)_[failed when required by the accredited person to give your name and address]_
(D)_[when required by the accredited person to give your name and address gave false details, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSE DETAILS GIVEN..)]_
(E)_[when required by the accredited person to give your name and address gave inaccurate details, namely **(..SPECIFY THE INACCURATE DETAILS GIVEN..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 3 of Schedule 5 to and section 50 of the Police Reform Act 2002.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person whom a person accredited under the Police Reform Act 2002 had reason to believe
had been/was engaging in anti-social behaviour
failed when required by the accredited person to provide your name and address OR
when required by the accredited person to provide your name and address gave false or inaccurate details

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The legislation has been changed from "acting in anti-social manner" to "engaging in anti-social behaviour"; for previous standard offence wording before 3rd April 2017 refer to CJS Code PL02031.
(ii) See also other offence wordings in relation to the duties of accredited persons:
H4915 - failed to give name and address to accredited person - relevant offence
H4944 - contravene accredited person's requirement to surrender liquor
H4945 - contravene accredited person's requirement not to consume liquor
H4946 - fail to stop vehicle as directed by an accredited person while escorting load
H4947 - drive vehicle - fail to proceed as directed by an accredited person while escorting load
H4948 - pedestrian fail to proceed as directed by an accredited person while escorting load

other.powersofarrest: An accredited person does not have a power of arrest or to detain - however as with any criminal offence a police officer may arrest without warrant.
other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level three on the legislative standard scale
